findings.claim: The proposed PLAN reuses the exact installed-only grant checks without changing legacy admission.
findings.evidence: 材料中 PROPOSED DIFF 显示在 ecommerce_workshop_read_catalog.py 新增 get_installed_readiness，并将原 get_readiness 的 legacy 成功分支后的 fallback 改为调用新方法：'return self.get_installed_readiness(**scope)'；同时方案说明‘把现有get_readiness的installed factory与原exactgrant/allowedblocker校验代码原样提取到此方法’。BASELINE 中 get_readiness 在 AssetNotFound 后直接展开 installed 校验逻辑，PROPOSED 将其移位进新方法。

findings.claim: The proposed PLAN scopes the new zero-list fallback to Source GET and preserves blocked facts and command gates.
findings.evidence: 材料中 PROPOSED DIFF 对 routers/ecommerce_workshop.py 的 Source GET 端点注入 _require_visible_read_workshop_installation 并新增 read_catalog 依赖，且方案声称‘源服务/SourceReady判断/全部POST/其他GET不改，原blocked12保持’；测试计划声称‘actualcanonicalfacade 12blocked envelope unchanged’。但 PROPOSED DIFF 未包含 Source facade 当前实现以核对 blocked 保留机制，也未给出命令门（command gates）不变的任何行级证据，且方案正文与 diff 对命令端点是否受新 helper 影响表述不一致。

result.next_safe_step: 修正 claim 1 的矛盾：在 plan-review-package-r3.txt 中明确说明 get_installed_readiness 为提取方法、原 get_readiness 不再重复执行 installed-only 校验，并附提取前后代码对照行号；同时提供 routers/ecommerce_workshop.py 命令端点依赖列表与 blocked 保留证据，或确认命令端点不受新 helper 影响的具体行引用。
